title: A globally framed relative torsor gives the inverse-section pushout
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion and $j:W=T-Z\hookrightarrow T$ its open complement [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $G$ be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], let $P$ be a $G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor], and fix a global section $e\in P(T)$ and a section $s\in P(W)$. Write $s=g+e|_W$ with $g\in G(W)$, using additive notation for the action. Let $\beta(P,s)\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_T(i_*\mathbf Z_Z,G)$ be the extension characterized by an equivariant map $F:P\to\mathcal E$, whose image is the fibre over supported one, with $F(s)=0$ [lem-sp-relative-torsor-extension]. Then $\beta(P,s)$ is the pushout of
$$0\to j_!\mathbf Z_W\to\mathbf Z_T\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z\to0$$
along the map adjoint to $1\mapsto-g$. In particular this assertion concerns the specified relative extension, not just its image in ordinary $H^1$.
For every short exact sequence $0\to H\to K\to G\to0$ of abelian etale sheaves, let $k\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_T(G,H)$ be its extension class and $\delta_W:G(W)\to H^1(W,H)$ its connecting map [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-pc-ext]. Under the supported-Hom and signed relative identifications [lem-amb-closed-support-hom, def-amb-relative-etale-cohomology], normalized on an injective resolution by $z\mapsto(z\circ p,0)$ with $p:\mathbf Z_T\to i_*\mathbf Z_Z$, the Yoneda splice satisfies
$$k[1]\circ\beta(P,s)=-\partial\delta_W(g)\quad\text{in }H^2_Z(T,H).$$
Here supported cohomology is derived kernel-of-restriction cohomology [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections], the relative differential is $D(a,b)=(da,\operatorname{res}(a)-db)$, and $\partial[b]=[(0,-b)]$. These identifications commute with etale restriction of the pair and with morphisms of coefficient short exact sequences. For $G=\mathbf G_m$, the map $1\mapsto-g$ means the inverse unit $g^{-1}$.
